closedFindings.correction: Unexpected ordinary Exception invokes owned cleanup and becomes typed unknown; BaseException also attempts owned cleanup then reraises. Cleanup failure is carried as cleanup_unconfirmed.
closedFindings.evidence: New RecursionError injection requires owned closure, typed unknown, reacquirable lock and a subsequent read-only request.

quarantineAssessment: Core close retains the exact session/Popen marked closing when wait or stream cleanup fails. _session retries that cleanup before any replacement spawn; the new wait-failure test checks no replacement and a released adapter lock. Two adjacent shared-core lifecycle gaps remain below.

openFindings.trigger: An untraced/legacy request sets cancel_requested and its final _close_input_session raises input_cleanup_unconfirmed.
openFindings.path: Legacy finally still directly calls _close_input_session followed by _LOCK.release. The cleanup exception skips release.
openFindings.consequence: The global lock stays held; subsequent requests or close_input_session cannot retry the quarantined worker. This is the currently active production path while SDK/Node do not establish context.
openFindings.recommendation: Use a nested try/finally in the legacy request finalizer so lock release is unconditional, retaining the precise quarantined Popen and typed cleanup evidence.
openFindings.validationNeeded: Exercise no-context cancellation plus controlled cleanup/wait failure; require quarantine, prompt structured failure, released global lock and no replacement spawn before confirmed cleanup.

openFindings.origin: Pre-existing setup ordering exposed by the new ownership/quarantine review, not introduced by the adapter exception fix.
openFindings.trigger: Popen succeeds but os.set_blocking(child.stdin.fileno(), False) raises before _SESSION is assigned.
openFindings.path: The only reference is the local child. Adapter _close_owned observes _SESSION=None and cannot close/quarantine that exact Popen.
openFindings.consequence: A later request can create a replacement while the earlier owned input worker remains untracked and potentially alive.
openFindings.recommendation: Register the exact newly spawned child before descriptor setup, with a nonreusable initialization/quarantine state. Route setup failure through confirmed close/quarantine before permitting replacement.
openFindings.validationNeeded: Inject set_blocking failure after an owned safe worker starts, require confirmed cleanup or retained exact quarantine, and prove a second spawn is barred while cleanup is unconfirmed.
